correctness.rationale: The infection and best-response equations match the original model. The first updater split, two fair first-appearance races and strict-inequality boundary cases form an exhaustive partition almost surely. value.rationale: The result exactly closes the smallest nontrivial (n=3) complete-graph instance of a parameter interval left untreated by a major model-specific classification, producing three intrinsic threshold boundaries and four qualitatively distinct probability laws, including almost-sure full infection despite initial safety. It also determines the entire joint limiting infection/action law. This is a natural complete classification with direct interpretation, not an arbitrary sample or routine numerical extrapolation. Scope is appropriately limited; no claim is made for larger populations.
